title: Circular Palm Rubbing
summary: The palms make small, controlled circular movements over the soft tissues of the back.
goal: Increase local warmth and prepare the tissues for kneading without deep pressure.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of circular palm rubbing without text labels.
startingPosition: The person lies face down. Keep the full palm in contact with the selected soft-tissue area.
instructions: Place the palm on the soft tissue of the back.
Make small circular movements without working directly over bony prominences.
Gradually move the circles to the neighboring area.
Avoid direct pressure on the spine and ribs.
direction: Small circles that gradually travel across the selected area.
tips: Keep the circles small and controlled.
Start lighter and increase pressure only when comfortable.
mistakes: Rubbing across the bony edge of the scapula.
warning: Do not perform this technique over acute pain, recent injury, significant inflammation, damaged skin, or when touch increases symptoms. Seek qualified professional advice when uncertain.
